g.text: PX4 Execution Loops and Data Flow
IMU, GNSS and control · worker ownership above; retained topics below
NuttX scheduling / drivers + PX4 execution contexts
uORB — retained topics + notification; NOT a broker thread

text.tspan: 2 ISR schedules IMU driver on bus worker
6 uORB notifies EKF2; EKF2 runs on INS0
7 GPS task parses UART + publishes sensor_gnss
9 EKF2 reads GNSS during an IMU-driven Run()
and fuses it when delayed-horizon eligible
• modules run in different execution contexts
• work queues execute work items sequentially
• uORB stores retained typed data + notifies subscribers
• notification calls ScheduleNow() on the target work item
• EKF2 is primarily IMU-triggered and consumes GNSS when available
• exact thread count depends on board + configuration
